name: Sceptre of Light
objectiveText: Get the Sceptre of Light and then return it to Azore Aldamort at the tower in Ethel Rethor. Sceptre of Light  ( 1 )

quest giver...39 27
burning blade seer...55 30 (if he is not there...he will be soon...just wait for spawn)

1.  Enter main gate at 56, 30
2.  make a left
3.  Go up free standing tower killing mobs on the way
4.  When you get to the top, solo pull the outter two guards if any
5.  Go through the opening of the tower on top and kill the seer and his buddy

Note - this quest causes confusion because you can't see the guys in the top of the tower.  Anotherwords you can't target through them, so many don't realize they are actually in there.

You get this quest from Azore Aldamort, 38, 27 in Desolace.

Go to Thunder Axe Fortress in Desolace to get the sceptre.
Enter the fort and go left. DO NOT go into the main building.  
Go up the left watch tower (open, stick-built structure).  There was an Augur at the base, a Felsworn on the 2nd level, and two Felsworns on the edge of the top level. Then inside there was an Augur with the Seer. 

My main problem was I didn't go up the tower far enough.  Once you go up one level, there is a ramp on the outside of the structure that will allow you to go up to the top.  Keep climbing until you find the seer.  Seer is always there and always drops the sceptre.

Enter the fort. Swing left, you'll see a watch tower. Dont get the watch tower confused with the adjacent building-NOT the building. Usually there's an Augur at the base, a Felsworn on the second level, and two Felsworns on the edge of the top level. Inside there's usually an Augur accompanying the Seer, so expect two.

I did this with my 33 Priest. I Mind Controlled the Augur (2 lvls below the seer), and pumped out as many spells as i could before it wore off, rinse and repeat until the Seer almost killed Augur. Finished Augur with Smite, two Mind Blasts later Seer was dead too.

Case anyone was wondering, in the adjacent building theres a lvl 36 Burning Blade Night Elf, named like Tyranis or somethin. Believe hes used in a quest here.
replies: Tyranis is part of a quest called Search for Tyranis, which is part of a chain of quests starting with Vahlarriel's Search, which you can pick up from Vahlarriel Demonslayer at Nijel's Point.  This quest is only for the Alliance.

Stand on the center of the stone bridge that leads to the closed tower.  If you look down to the right, you'll see a path directly under the bridge.  This path leads to Azore Aldamort, who is on the right side of the mountain that the closed tower sits on.

Jump off the bridge and follow the path to the ruins that are next to / below the base of the tower's right side.

comments.body: [Classic] The Seer at the top of the watchtower has a long respawn time and does not seem effected by the dynamic spawning mechanic. I'd approximate it at about 10 minutes.

Yep, coords confirmed: 55, 30. Make sure you follow the path all the way around. I got up to the top, saw a felsworn and left, since I saw no seer immediately. The seer is actually inside the tower, rather than on the platforms outside.

This guest was pretty easy with lvl 33 rogue, just stealthing into [b]55,30[/b] top of the tower, killing the mobs outside it (3 pieces of lvl 30-32), then inside of it there is one lvl 33 (the seer) and other mob which is lvl 30. Seer dropped it.

You need to enter the fortress through the main gate (56,30).
Sceptre of Light drops of a Seer on top of the 1st watch tower to the left past the gates.

Enter Ethel Rethor, in northwestern Desolace. Walk up to the big tower. Take a look off the ledge to your right and you'll see another ledge, with a table and some little columns at its end. Jump down there and Azore Aldamort is there.

Jumping isn't necessary, but I can't really describe how to find the path up to him - not enough landmarks. Take note of how to get there without jumping, once you get there.
